subject: maths
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: A shape is reflected in the y-axis. A point lying exactly on the y-axis is described as:
questions.explain: A point on the line of reflection does not move, so it is invariant.

questions.q: Two triangles are similar with a scale factor of 3. A side of 4 cm on the small triangle matches which side on the large one?
questions.explain: Multiply by the scale factor: 4 x 3 = 12 cm.

questions.q: The point (5, 2) is reflected in the line y = x. What is its image?
questions.explain: Reflecting in y = x swaps the coordinates: (2, 5).

questions.q: Which column vector translates a shape 4 units left and 1 unit up?
questions.explain: Left is negative x and up is positive y, giving (-4, 1).

questions.q: In a parallelogram, one angle is 70 deg. What is the size of an adjacent angle?
questions.explain: Adjacent angles in a parallelogram are co-interior and sum to 180 deg, so 180 - 70 = 110 deg.

questions.q: An equilateral triangle has all sides equal. What is the size of each interior angle?
questions.explain: Angles sum to 180 deg and all three are equal, so each is 180 / 3 = 60 deg.

questions.q: The bearing of B from A is 070°. What is the bearing of A from B?
questions.explain: A back bearing adds 180°, so 070° + 180° = 250°.

questions.q: The point (2, 7) is reflected in the y-axis. What is its image?
questions.explain: Reflecting in the y-axis negates the x-coordinate: (-2, 7).

questions.q: Three angles meet at a point and are 120°, 150° and x. What is x?
questions.explain: Angles around a point sum to 360°, so x = 360° − 120° − 150° = 90°.

questions.q: Add the column vectors (2, 3) and (-5, 1).
A line that touches a circle at exactly one point is called a:
questions.explain: A tangent meets the circle at exactly one point.

questions.q: A line drawn from the centre of a circle to a point on the circumference is called the:
questions.explain: A radius joins the centre to the circumference.

questions.q: What is the size of each interior angle of a regular octagon?
The bearing of Q from P is 210 deg. What is the bearing of P from Q?
questions.explain: Since 210 is more than 180, subtract: 210 - 180 = 030 deg.

questions.q: A shape is enlarged by scale factor 2. Its area is multiplied by what?
questions.explain: Area scales by the square of the scale factor: 2^2 = 4.

questions.q: Three angles of a quadrilateral are 90°, 100° and 80°. What is the fourth angle?
questions.explain: Angles in a quadrilateral sum to 360°, so 360° − 90° − 100° − 80° = 90°.

questions.q: The point (4, -6) is reflected in the x-axis. What is its image?
questions.explain: Reflecting in the x-axis negates the y-coordinate: (4, 6).

questions.q: A shape is enlarged by scale factor 1/2. A side of length 8 cm becomes how long?
questions.explain: Lengths multiply by the scale factor: 8 × 1/2 = 4 cm.

questions.q: A shape is translated by the column vector (6, 0). Which statement is true?
questions.explain: A positive x-component with zero y-component moves the shape 6 units right.

questions.q: A triangle is rotated 90° clockwise about the origin. The point (1, 0) maps to which point?
questions.explain: A 90° clockwise rotation about the origin sends (1, 0) to (0, -1).

questions.q: What single transformation maps a shape onto its image of the same size but on the opposite side of the y-axis?
questions.explain: Same size on the opposite side of a line describes a reflection in that line.
